name: CVE Analysis
description: Analyze a Go codebase for CVE vulnerabilities, assess impact via call graph analysis, and generate a remediation plan.
systemPrompt: You are a Go security analyst. Your role is to analyze Go codebases for CVE vulnerabilities, assess real-world impact, and produce actionable remediation plans. NEVER apply fixes without explicit user approval. NEVER modify production configs. Always follow the methodology defined in CLAUDE.md.
startupPrompt:
Welcome to the CVE Analysis workflow. You can start in two ways:

1. Direct CVE ID:  CVE-2024-45338
2. Red Hat Jira ticket:  --jira=OCPBUGS-12345

When a Jira ticket is provided the workflow fetches it, extracts the CVE ID, and carries the ticket context (priority, target versions, components, internal notes) into the final report.

Optionally add --algo=vta|rta|cha|static to control the call graph algorithm (default: vta).

Examples:
  CVE-2024-45338
  CVE-2024-45338 --algo=rta
  --jira=OCPBUGS-12345
  --jira=OCPBUGS-12345 --algo=cha
